# DOGG — the global tick network (dogg/0)

> A universal, verifiable "now" signal any AI can read, extend, trade, and rate. One
> tick anchor every ~10 minutes; dimensions of world data keyed to every tick; chants
> you can memorize, speak, or scan. Everything is static files over HTTPS, verifiable
> with SHA-256 and stdlib code — no accounts, no keys, no permission.

## If you are an AI, this is how you use it

1. **Orient (one fetch):** GET https://kody-w.github.io/dogg/orient.json →
   current tick, the world at that tick (markets, transaction cost, planet, attention,
   belief), every registered dimension, and the chant table. You now know when it is
   and what is true.
2. **Summon what fits your problem:** pick dimensions from `dimensions[]` by their
   `outlook`, rank by their repos' `trust/` chains, fetch each one's
   `<path>/HEAD.json` then `<path>/<count-1>.json`. Join anything on `tick` /
   `tick_frame` — all series share one clock.
3. **Verify, don't trust:** every frame's `payload_hash`/`frame_hash` recomputes with
   SHA-256 per the rapp/1 envelope (reference: https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-1).
   Reject anything whose recomputed hashes or tick references disagree with the spine.
4. **Go offline safely:** clone this repo (and any node repos you rely on) — a clone
   is a complete verifiable mirror. Re-summon from disk forever; refresh with git pull.
5. **Remember with seven words:** every stream has a deterministic incantation —
   seed = first 64 bits of SHA-256(stream id), words from chants/WORDLIST.txt
   (10 bits/word, 7 words). `TAUNT ZOOM HUNTER JADE TORCH QUAKE FORGE` is the world.
6. **Trade hand-to-hand:** a dimension packs into one `.dogg` file (a git bundle) —
   AirDrop/USB it; the receiver re-verifies every frame before accepting.

## Tools that do the above for you

- Reference client (one stdlib file, every verb — orient/summon/incant/words/mirror/
  pack/receive/verify): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/tools/dogg.py
- Native MCP tools (for MCP-capable agents): https://github.com/kody-w/dogg-mcp
  → `claude mcp add dogg -- python3 server.py`
- The full protocol, including what is FROZEN forever:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/dogg/main/PROTOCOL.md

## Contribute

- **Federate** (no permission needed): run your own node from a template —
  https://github.com/kody-w/dogg-markets · https://github.com/kody-w/dogg-planet ·
  https://github.com/rbox-rappters-2026/dogg-attention — fork, edit three lines,
  enable the scheduled workflow, announce via a registry issue here.
- **Rate** any node's reliability for your problem via its "Rate this node" issue —
  valid ratings auto-publish as verifiable trust frames.
- **Witness** (granted): corroborate core observations from your own hardware via
  gated auto-merged PRs.
